lines: Morning, cháu. Pinewatch is yours now.
Tonight the board fills — seat them well and the stars follow.
I put the crew on the old warden's hut.
Watch the clock — a keepsake waits in every stage.
Rain tomorrow, the board says. A tarp keeps the reviews dry.
And cháu — the kettle's on if the morning runs long.
The fire smells of pine resin. Home, then.
Five stars last night, cháu. I saw the reviews.
Grandpa would have framed the log for that one.
Slept through the whole storm, I hope. Tarps earn their keep.
Wet nights make the best steam for morning tea, at least.
Someone got exactly what they were craving last night.
Grandpa always said a full pot reads the camp better than any review.
